Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Instructor cohort — request for additional instructor access vouchers

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last month — the team was impressed by the latency and how students can iterate in-class. We run a July instructor cohort and had planned to give every instructor a 30-day trial voucher; demand is higher than expected. Can Redwood issue an extra 120 instructor vouchers (30-day trials) and extend the current promo window by 45 days for this cohort?

Quick context: these are instructor accounts (not student accounts) tied to a professional onboarding bundle. We need the codes to be active by Friday 7/17 so instructors can distribute them before the live sessions.

If there are any budget or SLA caveats on bulk trial extensions, please flag them. We have a POC (purchase-order) conversation in parallel but need the codes sooner.

Thanks,
Emma Park
Head of Partnerships, TeachLoop
emma@teachloop.org

Hi Emma — appreciate the heads-up and congrats on the higher turnout. Short answer: we can do 120 instructor 30-day trial vouchers and extend the promo window by 45 days. A couple of quick notes and asks so we can provision safely:

- We treat instructor accounts as full-featured (higher token allowances) — please confirm these will be assigned to named instructors and not opened up to students.
- We have two provisioning options:
  1) Batch CSV of voucher codes (you distribute) — fastest, we can deliver by EOD Thu 7/16 if you confirm counts.
  2) Managed redemptions (we issue single-use links and monitor redemptions) — requires a short SOW and verification, takes ~3 business days.
- For bookkeeping, Marissa will need an internal approval to convert these into promo vouchers (they'll be provisioned against the marketing promo pool).

If you want the CSV now, send me the instructor count broken out by region (US/EU/APAC) and any email domains we should whitelist.

I cc'd Marissa and Markus to expedite approval.

Best,
Ben
